description: Inner green-frame scoring regions in original image pixels (x right, y down). Corner order: top-left, top-right, bottom-right, bottom-left. A detection counts when its box centre is inside or on the polygon boundary.

provenance.method: Inner wire edges measured from wire-colour profiles at six positions per side on the photograph (not from annotation extents); least-squares line per side; corners = line intersections. Each corner was then visually checked in 240 px zoomed crops.
provenance.note: Proposed coordinates. A person should confirm them before the evaluation is treated as verified.

unseen_img2.note: No frame is visible. The whole 500 x 500 image is the region; no physical quadrat area is implied.
